subject.title: Foreground reply fence (automatic mode) cancels delivery of completed replies to earlier concurrent group messages — reply shown in dashboard, never delivered to WhatsApp

question: For group chats, should a newer visible reply be allowed to suppress a completed reply for a different inbound message, or must freshness be isolated per inbound message?
rationale: The source-correlated recurrence includes different topics from the same sender, so sender scoping is insufficient; choosing between per-message isolation, a narrower group rule, or target-level supersession changes the product's conversation-ordering contract.

options.title: Use group per-message fences
options.body: Isolate group-chat foreground fences by inbound message while retaining the existing target-level behavior for direct chats.

options.title: Keep target-level freshness
options.body: Retain current suppression semantics and accept that an earlier completed group reply may be discarded after a newer visible reply.

options.title: Adopt another explicit group policy
options.body: Define a documented group-specific supersession rule before implementing a scoped fence change.

recommendation.title: Use group per-message fences
recommendation.body: Isolate group-chat foreground fences by inbound message while retaining the existing target-level behavior for direct chats.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged fence implementation is the direct provenance trail for the contract now requiring clarification.
